# Global chip supply tightens, prices still climbing  
**Bottom line:** Market supply risk eases modestly but remains elevated; price pressure stays high, so lock in volumes now.

## What changed
- Market supply risk fell 8.1 points to **70.6** (still “Elevated”) as producer‑price momentum slowed the slide [1].  
- Price trend dropped 10.3 points to **84.0**, yet remains in the “Rising” band, driven by a 9.1% annualized PPI gain [1].  
- Memory segment price trend slipped 10 points to **85.8** (“Rising fast”), reflecting the same PPI pressure [1].  
- TSMC foundry loading surged 50.9% YoY through Sep 2026, tightening supply across logic and memory [4].  
- Trade‑press tone stays net‑tightening (+0.91) with 79 stories in 30 days, reinforcing higher‑price expectations [3].

## Alerts  
- **Score jump – Market supply risk down 8 pts to 71** – driven by strong producer‑price momentum [1].  
- **Score jump – Market price trend down 10 pts to 84** – despite the dip, pricing pressure stays high [1].  
- **Score jump – Memory price trend down 10 pts to 86** – PPI still pushes memory prices upward [1].

## Segment board  
- Processors & advanced logic — Supply **69.3** (‑7.6) “Rising”, Price **77.4** “Rising”, High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) — Supply **72.1** (‑7.4) “Elevated”, Price **85.8** “Rising fast”, High confidence.  
- Analog & power — Supply **67.7** (‑5.3) “Rising”, Price **84.4** “Rising”, High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded — Supply **69.6** (‑5.9) “Rising”, Price **83.3** “Rising”, High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) — Supply **65.9** (‑4.5) “Rising”, Price **83.5** “Rising”, High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9‑0SIT** (memory) – Supply **81.9** “Elevated”; 52‑week lead time vs ~12 wks norm.  
- **MT40A1G16TB‑062E:F** (memory) – Supply **81.9** “Elevated”; same 52‑week lead.  
- **10M08SAE144C8G** (logic) – Supply **80.6** “Elevated”; 52‑week lead.  
- **STM32F407VGT6** (MCU) – Supply **80.6** “Elevated”; 52‑week lead.  
- **XC7A35T‑1CSG324C** (logic) – Supply **80.6** “Elevated”; 52‑week lead.

## Outlook  
- **Chip prices next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.2 % (80 % range ‑9.6 % to +13.9 %); model‑tested edge [Outlook].  
- **Chip prices next 6 mo:** 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.3 % (80 % range ‑8.8 % to +17.5 %); baseline trend‑following [Outlook].  
- **Fab utilization next 3 mo:** 63 % chance supply tightens, +1.8 pts expected; baseline trend [Outlook].  
- **Fab utilization next 6 mo:** 60 % chance supply tightens, +3.6 pts expected; baseline trend [Outlook].

## Negotiation angle  
1. **Lock‑in volume discounts** for the five watchlist parts now; 52‑week lead times give suppliers leverage to charge premiums.  
2. **Ask for supply‑risk mitigation clauses** (e.g., priority allocation, penalty for late delivery) citing the elevated supply scores (70‑72) and TSMC loading data.  
3. **Push for price caps or forward contracts** on memory items where the price trend is “Rising fast” (85.8) and the 3‑month price‑rise probability is 66 %.
